name: NT Technology
summary: Katherine NT dialup/ISDN + hosting + web dev + internet cafe (15 PCs) ISP; defunct (NT TECHNOLOGY TRUST (trust), ABN 31 203 875 614).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of own domain (by 1997). Earliest verified Wayback capture 20 Apr 1997.

Last Wayback capture of own domain (c. 2003). Last explicitly ISP-branded homepage is Jun 2004; by Jun 2005 the site is an IT reseller with support contracts, so the retail ISP died c. 2004-05 — earlier than the proposed 2009 and later than the current 2003.

refs.label: Jun 2004 homepage still bills the firm as Katherine's ISP (same splash as Dec 2003).
By 15 Jun 2005 the redesigned site (built Mar 2004) is a generic IT-services business with webmail but no retail internet plans.
Oct 2009: internet access sold only as a Telstra BigPond dealer (plus own 'NomadNet' Wi-Fi hotspots), i.e. reseller not ISP.
